title: ufakzeka-kulak: Building and Evaluating a 31.6M-Parameter Turkish Speech Recognizer from Scratch
abstract: arXiv:2611.03605v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: ufakzeka-kulak is an open Turkish speech-to-text model of 31.6M parameters, a FastConformer encoder with a token-and-duration transducer (TDT) and a CTC head, trained from scratch and released under Apache-2.0. It writes cased, punctuated Turkish with numbers as words. Its 4,977 training hours come from sources whose licences allow commercial use; 281 hours are human-transcribed, and for the other 4,696 the training text is an uploader subtitle or a machine transcript, kept only where a second, independent reading of the audio agrees with it. The recipe, checkpoint, labelling and export choices were made on development data, and the test sets were scored once, in a release gate fixed before training. With greedy TDT decoding the normalised word error rate (WER) is 0.0921 (95 percent interval 0.0792 to 0.1055) on FLEURS Turkish test and 0.0916 (0.0873 to 0.0958) on Common Voice 27.0 Turkish test, lower than Whisper base and Whisper small

translated_title: ufakzeka-kulak：从零构建并评估一个31.6M参数的土耳其语语音识别模型
translated_abstract: ufakzeka-kulak 是一个开源的土耳其语语音转文本模型，拥有31.6M参数，采用FastConformer编码器，配备令牌与时长转换器（TDT）和CTC头，从零开始训练并以Apache-2.0许可证发布。它输出的土耳其语文本保留大小写和标点符号，数字以单词形式书写。其4,977小时的训练数据均来自允许商业使用的许可来源；其中281小时为人工转录，其余4,696小时的训练文本来自上传者的字幕或机器转录文本，且仅在音频的第二次独立听写与之相符时才予以保留。训练配方、模型检查点、标注和导出选择均基于开发数据确定，测试集仅在训练前固定的发布门控环节中评分一次。使用贪心TDT解码时，归一化词错误率（WER）在FLEURS土耳其语测试集上为0.0921（95%置信区间为0.0792至0.1055），在Common Voice 27.0土耳其语测试集上为0.0916（0.0873至0.0958），均低于Whisper base和Whisper small模型。
tldr: 该论文从零构建并开源了31.6M参数的土耳其语语音识别模型ufakzeka-kulak，仅使用可商业授权的数据训练，采用FastConformer编码器与TDT解码，在FLEURS和Common Voice土耳其语测试集上的词错误率均优于Whisper base和Whisper small。
en_tdlr: This paper builds and open-sources ufakzeka-kulak, a 31.6M-parameter Turkish speech recognizer trained from scratch with a FastConformer encoder and TDT decoding using only commercially licensable data, achieving lower word error rates than Whisper base and Whisper small on Turkish test sets.
